notes.title: Pre-order Madden NFL 23 now for the best rewards!
notes.content:
The All-Madden Team Elite Player item is only available if you pre-order the All Madden Edition before July 22. 

EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 23 features all-new ways to make a big impact on the field and control over decision along the way. Make dynasty-defining choices in Franchise with free agency and trade logic updates, play your way into the history books in Face of the Franchise: The League, and assemble your best Ultimate Team™ ever. New features across game modes give you more control than ever. 

For a limited time (until July 22), pre-order* the All Madden Edition and you can snag an All-Madden Team Elite Player in Ultimate Team! Choose one of the following 87 OVR players that comes equipped with a special ability: Barry Sanders, Cooper Kupp, Micah Parsons, or Kam Chancellor.
